invocation.output:
The tagline line still has straight quotes. The display may be misleading, so I’ll check each character’s code point directly.Those are plain ASCII quotes (0x22/0x27), not curly ones. I’ll rewrite the line using explicit Unicode escapes to avoid the encoding issue.Done. Line 3 now reads `Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’` with the intended code points.

- The first edit reported success, but the bytes on disk were straight quotes (`0x22`/`0x27`), so the transport normalized them.
- I rewrote just that line via a script using explicit `\u201c \u201d \u2018 \u2019` escapes and verified the bytes with `od`: `e2 80 9c … e2 80 9d … e2 80 98 … e2 80 99`.

Heads-up: tool output rendering may display these as straight quotes due to the same normalization; trust the byte check, and confirm in your editor if needed.
